title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient Descent (GD) is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent direction. The learning rate determines the size of the steps taken towards the minimum.

title: Effect of Increasing Learning Rate
text: Increasing the learning rate can lead to larger steps in the parameter space. This can affect the convergence behavior of the algorithm.

title: Possible Outcomes of Increasing Learning Rate
text: Consider what happens if the learning rate is too high. The algorithm might overshoot the minimum, leading to divergence or oscillation around the minimum.

hintAnswer: The path might overshoot or oscillate around the minimum.
